proof_scope: OpenAI interview context grounding through Brave raw web search plus CLI wiring.

claims.proves: brave-search can ground the public OpenAI/Astra interview context with raw web results and a retained readback oracle.
claims.does_not_prove: Brave Summarizer/LLM Context entitlement, paid Answers access, or correctness beyond returned public search results.

cases.name: openai-astra-public-context-search
command:
OUT=$(mktemp); ../run.sh web 'OpenAI Astra Critical cybersecurity capability threshold Preparedness Framework' --count 5 --json > $OUT && python3 - $OUT <<'PYCODE'
import json, sys
d=json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
text=json.dumps(d).lower()
assert 'openai.com' in text and 'astra' in text and 'preparedness framework' in text
print('OPENAI_ASTRA_CONTEXT_OK')
PYCODE

capability_claims.description: Brave raw web search returns public OpenAI/Astra context usable to ground Graham’s interview skill chain.
